counterfactual_missing_items: Anterior and posterior segment examinations, relative afferent pupillary defect testing, fogging test, and menace reflex were all normal
decisive_items: the patient was referred for psychiatric evaluation to rule out conversion disorder
response.rationale: R4 is the only candidate without a true contradiction; its support span directly indicates conversion disorder as the working diagnosis, and all other candidates are contradicted by normal objective tests (VEP, ERG, ocular exam, brain imaging). R3 and C1 are contradicted by normal VEP; R1 by normal ocular exam; R2 by normal brain imaging. The normal tests strongly support a functional etiology, making R4 the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: Visual evoked potentials were normal contradicts traumatic optic neuropathy.
Same contradiction as R3; bilateral modifier does not overcome normal VEP.
Normal anterior and posterior segment examinations contradict commotio retinae.
Normal brain imaging contradicts traumatic brain injury.
